system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

While you are in your Flash state you can spend a superiority die and choose a creature within the teleport's range. You swap places with that creature, and if they are a willing ally, you add the result of the superiority die roll to that creature's AC against the next attack targeting them. If the creature is unwilling, they must make on a Charisma saving throw against your Ninjutsu (or Taijutsu) save DC. On a failed save they swap places with you. An unwilling creature has their AC reduced by 2 until the end of their next turn..
